COOKIE NOTICE

Larkmoor Publishing Group Limited
Last updated: February 2, 2026

This notice explains how we use cookies and similar technologies on larkmoor.co.uk and our other websites. It should be read with our Privacy Notice, which explains how we handle personal data more generally.

WHAT COOKIES ARE

A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies include pixels, local storage, and software development kits in our mobile applications. We use the word "cookies" in this notice to cover all of them.

THE CATEGORIES WE USE

Strictly necessary cookies. These are required for the website to function: they keep you signed in, remember the contents of your basket, balance load across our servers, and protect against fraud. They are set on the basis of our legitimate interests and cannot be switched off in our cookie settings, because the site does not work without them.

Functional cookies. These remember choices you make, such as your region, your text size, and whether you have dismissed a banner. Without them the site works but is less convenient.

Analytics cookies. These tell us which pages are read, how long readers stay, and where they arrive from. We use them to improve the site. Analytics data is aggregated and we do not use it to identify you.

Advertising cookies. These are set by our advertising partners to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant advertisements on other websites. They may involve the sharing of an identifier with those partners.

YOUR CHOICES

Functional, analytics, and advertising cookies are set only with your consent. When you first visit the site you are shown a banner with an equally prominent "Accept all" and "Reject all", and a "Manage settings" link. You can change your choices at any time through the "Cookie settings" link in the footer of every page, and withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it.

Most browsers also let you block or delete cookies through their settings. Blocking strictly necessary cookies will prevent parts of the site from working.

HOW LONG COOKIES LAST

Session cookies are deleted when you close your browser. Persistent cookies last for a stated period: functional cookies for up to 12 months, analytics cookies for up to 13 months, and advertising cookies for up to 13 months, unless you delete them sooner.

THIRD PARTIES

The following partners set cookies through our site: Larkmoor Analytics Ltd (analytics), Corvid Media Exchange BV (advertising), and Halvard Video Services AS (embedded video). Each is an independent controller for the data it collects, and its own notice describes what it does with that data. Links are in our cookie settings panel.

INTERNATIONAL TRANSFERS

Where a partner processes data outside the United Kingdom, the transfer is made under the International Data Transfer Agreement or the UK Addendum to the EU standard contractual clauses, with a transfer risk assessment on file.

LEGAL BASIS

We rely on your consent for functional, analytics, and advertising cookies, as required by regulation 6 of the Privacy and Electronic Communications (EC Directive) Regulations 2003. We rely on our legitimate interests for strictly necessary cookies, which regulation 6 exempts from the consent requirement.

CHANGES

We may update this notice. When we do we will change the date at the top and, if the change is material, tell you through the site.

CONTACT

Data Protection Officer, Larkmoor Publishing Group Limited, 40 Bevis Marks, London EC3A 7BA. Email: dpo@larkmoor.co.uk.
